svg.title: Silver Key — Don't doubt. Don't be afraid. And know. Knowledge will save all.
svg.desc: Final softer holographic plate motion. Density remains the same as v0.5.11, but the temporal handoff is softened further: higher crossfade overlap, slower drift, more adjacent continuity, and fewer remote accents make the white light spots feel more like liquid light flowing across the pillar clusters. Motion stays uniformly distributed, begins during the group fade-in, and continues through the group fade-out. Each pillar sprite remains internally static; only whole-instance opacity changes. Approved Silver Key artwork, yellow annulus, fluid, text and 24-second cycle are unchanged.
